contracts_rationale: Contract-adoption mission: core adopts the published spec-kitty-events models; it defines no new API, schema or wire contract of its own.
purpose_context: Core keeps local copies of the decision-significance (RACI) event models, which can drift from the shared spec-kitty-events package. This mission refreshes the package lock to 11.3.0 and makes core use the package models, filling every RACI actor id with the operator-ruled sentinels, so persisted significance events validate against the shared contract (#6602, #6445).
purpose_tldr: Core uses the shared event package's decision-significance contracts instead of private copies.
